data.item: None Centum investment Company limited (nSe: iCDC, uSe: CenT) is a leading Pan-African investment company, that was established in 1967. it has interests in private equity and real estate investments in east Africa as well as investments in listed securities across sub- sahara Africa. The Company is listed on the nairobi Securities exchange (nSe) and cross-listed on the uganda Securities exchange (uSe). our investment portfolio consists of over 20 investee companies, consisting of wholly and partly owned subsidiaries,, associate companies and unquoted companies. Through our investments, we have been able to offer our shareholders access to quality and diversified investments. The history of Centum can be summarized as follows: FY1967/68 - 2008/09 Centum 1.0 Investment Focus: Generalist investor Significantly invested in quoted equities and private equity investments Investment management model: Passive portfolio investor. Investment Objective: To deliver market beating returns. FY2009/10- 20131/09 Centum 2.0 Investment Focus: Investment through 3 business lines:Private Equity, Quoted Private Equity and Real Estate Establishment of wholly owned Asset Management, Real Estate Development and Shared services busines to a allow focus on the management of third party funds. Investment management model: Active portfolio investor participating in value creation activities. Investment Objective: To deliver market beating returns. Centum 3.0 Investment Focus Investment in 8 sectors: Financial Services,Energy Agriculture,Education, Health, FMCG, ICT and Real Estate. Investment management model: Developer of investment grede opportunities in the 8 focus sectors. Investment Objective: To deliver market beating returns. | 10 |

data.item: CHAIRMAN’S STATEMENT We also intend to maintain our zero-dividend policy in the 2014/19 strategy period as the Board believes that Centum will require such dividend retention to support the ambitious growth objectives above. our decision to maintain the zero-dividend policy has been informed by the ability of Centum to grow the retained dividends at a rate higher than that offered by the nSe, an achievement we intend on maintaining into the next strategy period. To put this into perspective, an investment of Kshs 1.00 invested in Centum 5 years ago would be equivalent to Kshs 4.34 today. APPRECIATION i would like record my sincere gratitude to you, the shareholders, for the support you have continued to provide to your Company over the last strategic period. i would also like to recognize the contribution of the Board and Management teams of the companies in which we have invested, without which we would not have achieved the good performance which we have. Finally, i would like to appreciate the contribution and efforts of my fellow colleagues on the Centum Board and the Management team and urge the members of both groups to roll-up their sleeves as we start the journey to deliver on the 2014/19 strategic objectives. God bless you all. JAMES N. MUGUIYI CHAIRMAN

data.item: None 3. Tulinuia kuwekeza asilimia 50 ya rasilimali nje ya Kenya Huku tukikabiliana na changamoto ya kubadilika kila mara kwa mwishoni mwa kipindi cha mikakati.Tumewahi kuongeza mazingira ya kiuchumi humu nchini na kimataifa,uwezo wetu uwekezaji nje ya Kenya kutoka chini ya asilimia 1 hadi asilimia wa kudumisha uzalishaji wa faida ni kutokana na juhudi za 19 mwishoni mwa kipindi cha mikakati.Hiyo nyongesa ya Halmashauri ya Wakurugenzi na wasimamizi kufanya maamuzi asilimia 19 inawakilisha rasilimali yenye thamani ya Shilingi kwa haraka .Maamuzi hayo ya haraka yalikuwa muhimu katika bilioni 5.3 kulinganishwa na Shilingi bilioni 0.04 hapo mwanzo kutathmini hali ya mazingira ya utendaji kazi,kutambua nafasi ,zikiwa ni rasilimali zilizowekezwa nje ya Kenya na pia zilizoibuka, na kwa kutenga fedha zilizohitajika ,ili kuwezesha kulinganishwa na Shilingi bilioni 5.9 ya thamani za rasilimali mwenyehisa kuweza kupata manufaa zaidi zote . 4. Tunaelewa kwamba chapa nzuri itatuwezesha kutimiza ahadi KUHUSU CHAPA NA MAMBO YALIYOJIRI KATIKA MUUNDO wA tulizotoa.ili kuweza kutimiza hayo ,tumewahi kuimarisha KAMPUNI. maarifa katika usimamizi kwa kuajiri maafisa waliohitimu na wenye ujuzi wa muda mrefu kazini .Pia tumekuza taaluma ya Tuliangazia kutimiza ahadi tulizotoa kwa kutumia maafisa uongozi.Kutokana na kuweko kwa kundi stadi la usimamizi wetu ili kuimarisha Chapa yetu katika kipindi cha mikakati.Hili katika Centum ,tumewahi kutenda kuliko tulivyotarajia . limetuwezesha kuongeza thamani ya rasilimali ya mwenyehisa 5. Kipimo cha gharama za matumizi dhidi ya thamani ya ,jinsi inavyothibitishwa na kupanda kwa bei ya hisa zetu sokoni. rasilimali (tukitoa fedha chini ya usimazi kwa niaba ya wateja) kilipungua kwenye mwaka hadi asilimia 1.5 mnamo Machi 31 Hisa zetu zimekuwa zikifanya vyema katika kitengo husika la 2014 kutoka asilimia 2.3 cha mwaka uliotangulia.Kwa jumla Soko la hisa mwaka huu, na kwa hivyo kurekodi ongezeka la bei gharama ya matumizi kwenye kipindi hicho imekuwa chini ya kutoka Shilingi (k) 19.9 hapo 31 Machi 2013, hadi shilingi (k) 36.5 asilimia 2.3 ambayo ni afadhali kuliko kiwango cha asilimia mwishoni mwa mwaka. 2.5 kinachoruhusiwa. Bei ya hisa zetu dhidi ya thamani yake MAZINGIRA NA UTENDAJI KAZI Share price NAV 40.00 Hali ya uchumi ya Kenya iliendelea kuimarika kwenye kipindi cha 40 pili 2013 kulinganishwa na hali duni ilioshuhudiwa kwenye kipindi cha kwanza iliosababishwa na uchaguzi mkuu nchini Kenya. 30 34.47 Kipimo cha ukuaji wa uchumi (GDP) kiliongezeka hadi asilimia 20 5.2 ,4.3,na 4.6 katika vipindi vya robo vya mwaka 2013 hasa kwa sababu ya juhudi za kitaalamu za kifedha ,utalii, ujenzi na shughuli 8.9 10 za kilimo.Sarafu ya Kenya iliendelea kuwa imara na kubadilishwa 8.47 kwa kiwango cha shilingi 86 dhidi ya dola ya Marekani. 0 Mar 09 Mar 10 Mar 11 Mar 12 Mar 13 Mar 14 Jun 14 Mtazamo kwa muda mfupi na wastani wa hali ya uchumi ni kudumisha ukuaji kutokana na :wawezekaji wanayo imani juu ya hali ya biashara nchini baada ya uchaguzi wa amani uliofanyika Ari ya kuwa kampuni bora na kutimiza ahadi imetuwezesha Machi 2013,mvua kubwa,mazingira imara kiuchumi,kushuka kwa kupewa tuzo kadhaa: bei ya mafuta duniani ,shilingi ya Kenya kuendelea kuwa thabiti,na 1. Tuzo la ubora wa utoaji wa ripoti za kifedha( FiRe mabadiliko ya sera kuhusiana na usalama,usimamizi na maswala AWARDS,) 2013:Mshindi katika Afrika ya Mashariki.Hii ni ya haki . kuongezea tuzo zifuatazo:Mshindi-katika Kenya ,kitengo cha viwanda ,Biashara na huduma,Mshindi-Kitengo cha hisa Hali thabiti ya mazingira ya kutenda kazi ilipelekea kuimarika kwa zilizoorodheshwa ,na wa Pili , -iFRS. rasilimali zetu kwenye Kitengo cha Kibinafsi .Vile vile tuliangazia 2. Tuzo la Wanaozingatia usimamizi wa kimashirika: Wa pili Kitengo cha Hisa za Kibinafsi zilizoorodheshwa kwa kuwekeza ,Fedha na uwekezaji na pia wa pili Katibu wa kampuni wa zaidi nje ya Kenya ,ili kuepusha athari za kujipima dhidi ya soko mwaka . la hisa la nSe. 3. Tuzo la Wharton club for Africa (WCA) :Afisa Msimamizi mkuu wa Centum ,James Mworia alikuwa mshindi wa tuzo la Afisa lengo letu katika Kitengo cha nyumba na ujenzi ilikuwa kutatua Msimamizi Mkuu wa mwaka barani Afrika,kwenye kikao cha maswala yote kuhusiana na masharti yaliyokuweko ili kupata WCA kilicholeta pamoja wawekezaji barani Africa iliyofanyika idhini ya kuanza ujenzi wa mradi wa Two Rivers. nairobi hapo novemba. | 26 |

Mnamo Mwaka uliotangulia tuliwajulisha juu ya kuanzisha kampuni ukuaji huo ulitokana hasa na matumizi ya mikakati ya kipindi cha tanzu tukinuia kufanya Centum kuwa na uwezo wa kusimamia 2009/14 uliopelekea kubuniwa kwa vitengo hivi vitatu ;Kitengo cha fedha kwa niaba ya wateja.Kampuni tanzu tulizoanzisha ni : hisa za kibinafsi,Kitengo cha hisa za kibinafsi zilizoorodeshwa,na 1. Athena Properties limited-Kampuni ya Athena properties kitengo cha nyumba ,ujenzi na muundo misingi.Kulingana na ilibuniwa ili kusimamia ujenzi wa miradi yote ya Centum ,na manufaa tuliyoyapata kutokana na kuangazia nguzo hizo ,tukiwa pia miradi ya wateja wengine .Athena imefanikiwa kuajiri Halmashauri ya wakurugenzi tunaamini kwamba bado kunayo maafisa waliohitimu na wenye ujuzi wa zaidi ya miaka 100 fursa ya kufanya Centum kukua zaidi kupitia mikakati ya katika shughuli za ujenzi,humu nchini na pia kimataifa. kuangazia nguzo katika kila sekta. Kwenye kipindi hiki,Athena imeweza kuongeza thamani ya Kitengo cha nyumba,ujenzi na muundo msingi. Kufuatana na hayo, tutaangazia kuwekeza zaidi katika sekta 2. Centum Assset Managers limited-Kampuni ya Centum Asset 8 ,kwa miaka mitano yajayo;Bidhaa zianzouzwa kwa haraka Managers (CAM) kilibuniwa kwa madhumuni ya kuunda aina (FMCG),Huduma za kifedha, nyumba na ujenzi, Kawi, Afya, elimu, ya bidhaa za uwekezaji na usimamizi wa rasilimali kwa Kilimo, na Teknolojia. niaba ya wateja, pamoja na usiamamizi wa kitengo cha hisa zilizoorodeshwa.Kwa kuwa kundi la CAM wametenda vyema uamuzi wetu kuangazia sekta hizi ni kwa sababu ya ukubwa katika usimamizi wa kitengo hicho cha QPe ,ni dhahiri kuwa wa soko, kuwepo kwa dalili ya ukuaji ,na taaluma ya Centum wanayo uwezo wa kuvutia na kuigiza mbinu hiyo katika kukuza rasilimali ya hali ya juu.Kwa kuangazia sekta hizi ,tunayo usimamizi wa fedha kwa niaba ya wateja. nafasi nzuri kujenga kampuni bora ya kipekee ambayo licha ya 3. CSSl ni kuruhusu kila mteja wake kuweza kufanya kazi kwa kuzingatia nguzo yao. data.item: TAARIFA YA MwENYEKITI MGAO wA FAIDA Mnamo 2009/2010 Halmashauri ya wakurugenzi waliamua kutolipa mgao wa faida kwa muda wa miaka mitano ya utekelezaji wa mikakati.Kuambatana na hayo Halmashauri ya wakurugenzi haijapendekeza ulipaji wa mgao wa faida mwaka huu. Tunakusudia pia kudumisha sera ya kutolipa mgao wa faida katika kipindi cha mikakati cha 2015/19 kwa kuwa Halmashauri ya Wakurugenzi wanahitaji fedha hizo ili kufadhili mipango ya kuendeleza ukuaji wa kampuni ,jinsi ilivyotajwa hapo juu.uamuzi wetu wa kutolipa mgao wa faida ni kwa sababu ya uwezo wa Centum kuzalisha faida kutokana na fedha hizo kwa kiwango kinachoshinda cha soko la hisa la nSe, mafanikio tunayotarajia kudumisha katika kipindi cha mikakati kinachofuata.Kwa kufafanua ina maana kwamba shilingi 1 iliyowekezwa katika Centum miaka mitano iliyopita,itakuwa na thamani ya Shilingi 4.34 leo. SHUKRANI ningependa kutoa shukrani kwa nyinyi wenyehisa kwa kuendelea kuunga mkono kampuni yenu katika kipindi cha mikakati kilichopita.Pia ningependa kutambua mchango wa Halmashauri ya Wakurugenzi na makundi ya wasimamizi ya mashirika yetu ambamo tumewekeza ,kwa kuwa bila wao hatungepata matokeo hayo bora. Mwisho ningependa kupongeza Mchango wa wenzangu kwenye Halmashauri ya wakurugenzi ya Centum pamoja na kundi la Wasimamizi,na kuhimiza waendelee kutia bidii tunapoanza kutimiza malengo yaliyowekwa kwenye mikakati ya 2014/19 .na mwisho ni kwa Kundi la Centum kwa kujitolea kutenda kazi kwa makini ili kuwa na matokeo mema tunayoshuhudia. Mungu awabariki nyote. JAMES N. MUGUIYI MwENyEkITI

data.item: b) Mradi wa Pearl Marina Katika kipindi cha mikakati cha 2009-2014 utendaji wa kitengo cha QPe umeweza kushinda alama ya soko la nSe kwa wastani Tuko kwenye harakati ya kuanzisha ujenzi mradi wa Pearl wa asilimia 18 .Kwenye mwaka 203/2014 wa kifedha faida katika Marina ambapo tunatarajia kuzindua mnamo 2014 ,baada ya kitengo cha QPe kilishinda alama ya soko la nSe kwa asilimia kutimiza masharti yote yaliyohitajika. Mradi huu umeweza kuvutia 31.Faida ya kitengo hiki kufikia Machi 31, 2014 ilikuwa asilimia wawekezaji wa kutoka humu nchini na pia wa kimataifa na 33.Faida hiyo ilitokana na kuingia katika maeneo mengi kijogorofia unatarajiwa kuongoza kwa kuvutia watalii wengi katika Afrika ya ,huku tukimiliki zaidi ya asilimia 60 ya rasilimali katika masoko ya Mashariki .uchoraji wa mradi wa awamu ya kwanza umekamilika Afrika ,kusini mwa sahara. na kutakuwa na maduka ya kuuza nguo,hoteli yenye sehemu ya vilabu,Kumbi za mikutano,kituo cha biashara ,ukumbi wa kufanyia Kampuni ya Centum Assets Managers (CAM) ilikuwa miongoni mazoezi, bar ,aina mbalimbali ya michezo na bidhaa zinginezo za mwa zile za kwanza kupata leseni ya ReiT kutoka kwa halmashauri kustarehesha, na pia vyumba aina ya vila, vyenye mseto wa vitanda ya CMA.Kwa sasa tuko katika harakati ya kuanzisha bidhaa kwa 2,3,4 .Tunatarajia kutoa nafasi chache kwa wale watakaopenda jina D-ReiT na i-ReiT ambazo zitazaidia kuendeleza soko letu la uhuru wa kujenga jinsi wanavyotaka,wakati tutakapoanza ujenzi hisa na kuleta manufaa kwa washika dau wote humu nchini. wa hizo vila. Kampuni ya CAM pia imepata leseni kutoka shirika la Retirement c) uwekezaji katika Broll east Africa Benefit Authority (RBA) ili kuweza kusimamia fedha za malipo uzeeni.isitoshe, CAM pia iko katika harakati ya kuanzisha mpango Tulishirikiana na kampuni ya Broll Property Group ,ambayo ni wa uwekezaji utakaoleta pamoja washiriki kutoka bara lote la kampuni kubwa zaidi yenye kuhusika na nyumba za kibiashara Afrika. barani Afrika,katika kubuni Broll east Afrika.ushirikiano huo unatoa fursa kwa Centum kuweza kutimiza miradi ya ujenzi. uwekezaji katika kampuni ya investment Management limited. umiliki wa Centum katika shirika hilo ni asilimia 30. Centum ilikamilisha unyakuzi wa asilimia 73.35 ya Genesis investmet Management limited –ambayo ni kampuni ya pili ii, Hisa za kibinafsi zilizoorodeshwa. kwa ukubwa katika usimamizi wa fedha nchini kenya –na hivyo kusababisha ongezeko la shilingi bilioni 117 kwa fedha chini ya Mnamo mwisho wa mwaka wa kifedha ,thamani ya rasilimali usimamizi kwa niaba ya wateja kutoka shilingi bilioni 2.4 mwaka kwenye kitengo cha Hisa za kibinafsi Zilizoorodeshwa ilikuwa uliopita. shilingi (k) bilioni 5 na kuwakilisha asilimia 17 ya rasilimali zote za Centum.Kitengo kilizalisha mapato ya asilimia 35 ,au kwa Centum Business Solutions pesa taslimu Shilingi (k) milioni 1,753.Mapato hayo ni kutokana na mgao wa faida,riba,ada ya usimamizi, na faida kutokana na Kampuni ya Centum Business Solutions,CBS, ambayo hapo awali ukadiriji wa thamani ya rasilmali. ilijulikana kama Centum Shared services ilianzishwa katika kipindi cha mwaka huu.Hii imezaidia kutoa nafasi kwa kampuni Kitengo cha Hisa za kibinafsi zilizoorodheshwa kinategemea tanzu kuweza kuangazia shughuli ambazo ni nguzo zao na vilevile ujuzi wetu tuliopata kutoka kitenga cha hisa za kibinafsi kuweza kunufaika kutokana na huduma zinazofanana ,kuboresha utendaji kuwekeza katika yale mashirika yenye hali yanayofanana na kazi ,na kupunguza gharama za matumizi. za kibinafsi .Kitengo hiki kinazingatia hasa uwekezaji kwenye kampuni zilizoorodheshwa walakini hazijafanyiwa utafiti ya na huduma zinazofanana ,kuboresha utendaji kazi ,na kupunguza kutosha ,zenye fedha ,na zenye kuonyesha dalili ya kukua na gharama za matumizi. ambapo tunayo nafasi ya kupata umiliki. Maafisa wetu Jukumu la pili la kitengo cha QPe ni kuhakikisha kuwa hali ya fedha katika kampuni inasimamiwa vyema.Kitengo cha QPe huonyesha lengo letu katika kipindi cha mwaka lilikuwa kuongeza maarifa njia ya matumizi ya fedha za ziada na pia kusaidia kutoa dhamana kwa maafisa wanaohudumu na vilevile kutoa mafunzo ili kukuza kwa minajili ya mikopo,au katika uuzaji wa hisa sokoni. taaluma ya uongozi.Tuliweza kuajiri maafisa katika kitengo cha nyumba na ujenzi,sheria,na wataalamu katika mambo ya ushuru, Kitengo cha QPe pia huwezesha kukadiri juu ya thamani ya mambo ambayo yamekuwa muhimu kwa kuhakikisha kufaulu kampuni za kibinafsi kulinganishwa na thamani ya kampuni za kwa mikakati yetu ya ukuaji. umma katika masoko mengine barani Afrika. | 41 | None None

Mpango wa kutoa mafunzo kwa vijana c kutoka vyuo vikuu hivi majuzi na amba umefaidi wale waliochaguliwa kwa k sasa katika Centum.ili kuweza kuonge mpango huo pia unahusu baadhi yao ya Kenya,na ambapo kwa wakati huu Kiarie wanafanya kazi nchini Afrika ubadilishanaji. Kutokana na kufaulu kwa mpango hu kujiunga na Centum mnamo Julai maendeleo ya kampuni ,tumechagua 2 nchi mbali mbali kama vile Kenya,ug ,katika kanda ya Afrika ya Mashariki. Wataweza kufundishwa juu ya usimam kupewa fursa ya kusimamia miradi .Wa nafasi ya kuajiriwa katika Kampuni ya C Mikakati ya 2014-2019 Tarehe 31Machi 2014 ulikuwa wa mwish April 2014 ,bodi ya Centum ilitoa idhini ya miaka mitano hadi Machi 31, 2019,n 3.0.Centum 3.0 inatufanya kubadilisha wa rasilimali na kuwa yenye kuhusika n lengo letu ni kuangazia uwekezaji katik na ujenzi,Kawi,Huduma za kifedh zinazouzwa kwa haraka,Huduma za afy Malengo yetu muhimui katika Centum • Kupata zaidi ya asilimia 35 ya faida cha mikakati.Wakati wa mikakati y ya asilimia 31 kila mwaka • Kuangazia kuimarisha utendaji w uwekezaji hasa katika sekta mpya | 42 | wetu ni kukuza taaluma ya Centum 3.0 inatoa fursa zaidi ya utendaji kwa kuangazia sekta liwahi kutambua baadhi ya mbalimbali kufuatana na jinsi tulivyofaulu katika sekta ya adi mahali watakapokuwa Bidhaa zinazouzwa kwa Haraka ,Huduma za Kifedha na ya zi za juu ili kusaidia katika nyumba na ujenzi. jiandaa kufanya biashara • Kufanya kampuni kuwa thabiti kwa kuongeza thamani ya rasilimali ya Centum kufikia Shilingi (k) bilioni 120,na thamani ya rasilimali zote chini ya usimamizi (AuM) kufikia Shilingi (k) hipukizi ambao wamefuzu bilioni 720. o tulianzisha mnamo 2013 • Kuboresha Chapa Centum kupitia sifa ya maafisa wetu na uwa wanafanya kazi kwa kwa hivyo kukuza kundi lenye maarifa katika kila sekta. za maarifa na kupata ujuzi • Kudhibiti gharama za matumizi chini ya asilimia 2 ya thamani kuweza kufanya kazi nje ya rasilimali zote chini ya usimamizi.Tunalenga kudumisha ,Mehul Soni na lawrence sera ya kuweka gharama za matumizi chini ya asilimia 2.5 Kusini ,kwa mpango wa kilichoruhusiwa hapo mbeleni. BUSINESS LINE REVIEw PRIVATE EQUITY BUSINESS LINE REVIEw Introduction Private equity (Pe) is Centum’s largest business line accounting for approximately 49% of the total portfolio. Centum’s established track record, our proprietary deal flow, our networks in the private equity industry and our long established status - a channel through which investors can participate in Pe investments – makes Centum the partner of choice in east Africa’s private equity space. The Pe business line has invested in companies that largely serve the needs of the domestic and other African markets. The Pe investment strategy is underpinned by the growth in consumer spending and investment, which is being driven by economic growth. Pe aims to deliver a 30% - 35% return. Since 2009, Pe has pursued a three-pronged strategy in managing the business line: i. Active portfolio management to address underperforming assets and working with partners to implement value creation plans for each investee company. ii. Strengthening investment processes and relationships across the region to enable development of a proprietary pipeline of attractive opportunities and make quality investments structured to ensure alignment between Centum and its partners. iii. Pursuit of geographical diversification with a target to have 50% of assets invested outside Kenya by 2014.

Consisting of a mix of 72 two bedroom duplexes, 40 three bedroom villas and 16 five bedroom villas. The 128 units will be built in clusters, each cluster containing approximately 10 houses. The clusters are designed to provide both exclusivity and an element of community at the same time. As each cluster looks away from the other while each house has views of both the lake and the common loan at the center. Below is a view of phase on and the arrangement of the clusters. RISK MANAGEMENT REPORT RISK MANAGEMENT AND INTERNAL CONTROLS Introduction Comprehensive risk management practices form an integral part of the operations at Centum. The nature of business the company is engaged in exposes it to a slew of complex and variable risks. The rapid and continuous changes in the business environment have ensured that the organisation becomes increasingly risk focused to achieve its strategic objectives. Centum’s policies ensure timely identification, management and mitigation of relevant risks, such as credit risk, liquidity risk, interest rate risk, operational risk, reputational and regulatory risks, which help the company move forward with vigour. The Group’s robust risk management framework is driven by the following fundamentals: • To identify key risks • To evaluate the probability of occurrences and their impact • To position tolerance limits and establish adequate review mechanisms to monitor and control risks • To incorporate a robust reporting mechanism and to adopt appropriate mitigation processes The Group sees strong risk management capabilities as vital to the success of a well-managed investment company. The Risk Management (RM) function is the central resource for driving such capabilities in Centum. The key components of Centum’s risk management approach are: strong risk governance and culture; robust and comprehensive processes to identify, measure, monitor, control and report risks; sound assessments of investment opportunities relative to risks; and a rigorous system of internal control reviews involving internal auditors and other internal control units as well as external auditors. Risk Governance under the Group’s risk management framework, the Board of Directors, through the Board Risk Management Committee (BRMC), sets risk appetite, oversees the establishment of robust enterprise-wide risk management policies and processes, and sets risk limits to guide risk-taking within the Group. The Senior Risk officer (SRo) has been appointed to oversee the risk management function. The SRo is a member of the Group executive Committee and has a dual reporting line to the Ceo and to the Board. Working closely with the business lines, the SRo is responsible for the following: • Management of the risks in the Group including developing and maintaining systems and processes to identify, approve, measure, monitor, control and report risks; • Engagement of senior management on material matters relating to the | 77 |

data.item: The Kenyan Companies Act requires the directors to prepare financial statements for each financial year which give a true and fair view of the state of affairs of the Group and the Company as at the end of the financial year and of the Group’s profit or loss for that year. it also requires the directors to ensure that the company maintains proper accounting records that disclose, with reasonable accuracy, the financial position of the company. The directors are also responsible for safeguarding the assets of the company. The directors accept responsibility for the preparation and fair presentation of financial statements that are free from material misstatements whether due to fraud or error. They also accept responsibility for: (i) Designing, implementing and maintaining internal control necessary to enable the preparation of financial statements that are free from material misstatements, whether due to fraud or error; (ii) Selecting and applying appropriate accounting policies; and (iii) Making accounting estimates and judgements that are reasonable in the circumstances. The directors are of the opinion that the financial statements give a true and fair view of the state of the financial position of the Group and of the Company at 31 March 2014 and of the Group’s financial performance and cash flows for the year then ended in accordance with international Financial Reporting Standards and the requirements of the Kenyan Companies Act. nothing has come to the attention of the Directors to indicate that the company and its subsidiaries will not remain a going concern for at least the next twelve months from the date of this statement. Approved by the board of directors on 09 June, 2014 and signed on its behalf by: James Muguiyi James M Mworia Chairman Managing Director 09 June 2014 | 89 | None None
